info.cls_ename: Department of Aerospace and Systems Engineering

description.describe_ch: 材料力學(二)主要在講解各種載重造成元件產生的應力與應變等基本觀念，以啟發學生解決材料與結構的相關力學問題的能力。內容包括樑之應力與應變分析、平面應力與應變分析、樑之撓曲、柱之挫曲、及應力集中等。
description.describe_eh: Mechanics of Materials (2) is to make students soundly understand the behavior of solid bodies subjected to various types of loading. Contents include  stresses and strains in beams、 analysis of stresses and strains of plane stress、 deflection of beams、 buckling of columns、 and stress concentration。
description.pre_sub_ename: ENGS1006 APPLIED MECHANICS、ENGS2001 MECHANICS OF MATERIALS(1)

targets.describe_ch: 使學生能分析材料之剪應力與應變
targets.describe_en: To gain the ability to analyze all types of shear stresses and strains

targets.describe_ch: 使學生能分析簡支承樑與懸臂樑結構之應力與產生變形撓曲的關係
targets.describe_en: To gain the ability to analyze simply supported beams, cantilever beams and their induced stress and deformation

targets.describe_ch: 使學生能分析主應力、平面應力與應變問題
targets.describe_en: To gain the ability to analyze the principle stress, plane stress and plane strain

targets.describe_ch: 培養學生對結構及材料力學相關專業英語之認識
targets.describe_en: To gain the ability of recognizing the structural and material English terminology
